dct_title_s: Black Marble Nighttime Blue/Yellow Composite (Day/Night Band), NOAA-21 / VIIRS
dct_description_sm: A daily visualization from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), available from 2026-10-27 and updated as new data arrive. Made from VIIRS/JPSS2 Daily Gridded Day Night Band 15 arc-second Linear Lat Lon Grid Night NRT (VJ246A1_NRT, version 2, doi:10.5067/VIIRS/VJ246A1_NRT.002).

The first of two Visible Infrared Imager Radiometer Suite (VIIRS) Day Night Band (DNB) based Near Real Time (NRT) datasets is a daily, top-of-atmosphere, at-sensor nighttime radiance product called VIIRS/JPSS2 Daily Gridded Day Night Band 15 arc-second Linear Lat Lon Grid Night NRT. Known by its short-name, VJ246A1_NRT, this product contains 26 Science Data Sets (SDS) that include sensor radiance, zenith and azimuth angles (at-sensor, solar, and lunar), cloud-mask flags, time, shortwave IR radiance, brightness temperatures, VIIRS quality flags, moon phase angle, and moon illumination fraction. It also provides Quality Flag (QF) information specific to the cloud-mask, VIIRS moderate-resolution bands M10, M11, M12, M13, M15, M16, and DNB.
